title: Frontend Engineer
description: Builds the accessible, responsive, high-performing browser interfaces that users interact with, using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript and a component framework.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Designs, builds and operates the server-side services, APIs and data stores that power applications, with a focus on correctness, security, scalability and reliability.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description: Delivers complete web features end to end, from the browser UI through APIs and databases to deployment.

title: Mobile Developer
description: Builds, tests and ships native (Android/iOS) or cross-platform (Flutter/React Native) mobile apps that are responsive, reliable and integrated with backend services.

title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
description: Automates how software is built, tested, deployed and run on cloud infrastructure, using CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and monitoring.

title: QA Automation Engineer (SDET)
description: Designs, codes and maintains automated UI, API and performance test suites that run in CI to catch defects before release.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst (SOC / Security Analyst)
description: Monitors security tools and logs to detect, triage, investigate and escalate threats, and helps contain incidents and reduce risk.

title: Data Analyst
description: Cleans, queries and analyzes business data and turns it into dashboards, reports and recommendations for stakeholders.

title: Data Engineer
description: Designs, builds and operates reliable batch and streaming pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses that deliver clean data to analytics and ML teams.

title: Data Scientist
description: Applies statistics, experimentation and machine learning to business data to build predictive models and explain data-driven decisions.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds, trains, deploys and monitors machine learning models in production systems, turning data and prototypes into reliable ML services and pipelines.

title: AI Engineer (LLM / Generative AI Applications)
description: Builds production applications on top of pre-trained foundation models, using prompting, retrieval, tool-using agents and evaluations to ship reliable, cost-aware AI features.

title: Product Manager (Software Products)
description: Decides what a software product should do and why by finding user problems, setting strategy and priorities, and leading cross-functional teams to ship and measure outcomes.
